# `{upxdvir}` Demo

## Libraries

```{r imports}
library(grid)
library(upxdvir)
```

```{r setup, echo = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = TRUE)
drawGrid <- function(border = TRUE) {
    if (border) {
        grid.rect(gp = gpar(lwd = 10, col = 2))
    }
    grid.segments(
        c(0, .5),
        c(.5, 0),
        c(1, .5),
        c(.5, 1),
        gp = gpar(lty = 4, col = "gray", alpha = .5)
    )
}
```

## Examples

### Vertical Typesetting

```{r vert, fig.align = "center", fig.height = 4, fig.width = 4}
drawGrid()
grid.uplatex(
    "The text is rendered vertically by default.",
    y = .8,
    direction = 0
)
grid.uplatex("「JRまで 0.5 km」と聞いた。", gp = gpar(height = 1))
```

### Horizontal Typesetting

```{r horiz, fig.align = "center", fig.height = 4, fig.width = 4}
drawGrid()
grid.uplatex(
    "The \\texttt{direction = 0} parameter typesets text horizontally.",
    gp = gpar(width = unit(2, "in")),
    y = .75, direction = 0
)
grid.uplatex("「JRまで 0.5 km」と聞いた。", direction = 0)
```

## Regression Checks

```{r reg, fig.align = "center", fig.height = 4, fig.width = 4}
drawGrid()
grid.latex("LuaTeX", engine = "LuaTeX", y = .7)
grid.latex("XeTeX", engine = "XeTeX", y = .3)
```
